And thou--</hi>rather, "And if (carried on from <reference osisRef="Jer.4.1">Jr 4:1</reference>) thou shalt swear, 'Jehovah liveth,' in truth, &c.", that is, if thou shalt worship Him (for we swear by the God whom we worship; compare <reference osisRef="Deut.6.13">De 6:13</reference>; <reference osisRef="Deut.10.20">10:20</reference>; <reference osisRef="Isa.19.18">Is 19:18</reference>; <reference osisRef="Amos.8.14">Am 8:14</reference>) in sincerity, &c.<div eID="gen17017" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen17018" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">and the nations--</hi>Rather, this is apodosis to the "if"; then shall the nations bless themselves in (by) Him" (<reference osisRef="Isa.65.16">Is 65:16</reference>). The conversion of the nations will be the consequence of Israel's conversion (<reference osisRef="Ps.102.13">Psa 102:13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Ps.102.15">15</reference>; <reference osisRef="Rom.11.12">Ro 11:12</reference>, <reference osisRef="Rom.11.15">15</reference>). <div eID="gen17018" type="x-p"/>
entries.content_plain: 2. entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9660"/><div sID="gen17031" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9660"/><hi type="bold">10. thou hast ... deceived--</hi>God, having even the false prophets in His hands, is here said to do that which for inscrutable purposes He permits them to do (<reference osisRef="Exod.9.12">Ex 9:12</reference>; <reference osisRef="2Thess.2.11">2Th 2:11</reference>; compare <reference osisRef="Jer.8.15">Jr 8:15</reference>; which passage shows that the dupes of error were self-prepared for it, and that God's predestination did not destroy their moral freedom as voluntary agents). The false prophets foretold "peace," and the Jews believed them; God overruled this to His purposes (<reference osisRef="Jer.5.12">Jr 5:12</reference>; <reference osisRef="Jer.14.13">14:13</reference>; <reference osisRef="Ezek.14.9">Eze 14:9</reference>).<div eID="gen17031" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen17032" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">soul--</hi>rather, "reacheth to the life." <div eID="gen17032" type="x-p"/>

The false prophets foretold "peace," and the Jews believed them; God overruled this to His purposes ( Jr 5:12 ; 14:13 ; Eze 14:9 ). soul-- rather, "reacheth to the life."

entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9680"/><div sID="gen17074" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9680"/><hi type="bold">30. when thou art spoiled--</hi>rather, "thou, O destroyed one" [Maurer].<div eID="gen17074" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen17075" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">rentest ... face with painting--</hi>Oriental women paint their eyes with stibium, or antimony, to make them look full and sparkling, the black margin causing the white of the eyes to appear the brighter by contrast (<reference osisRef="2Kgs.9.30">2Ki 9:30</reference>). So the Jews use every artifice to secure the aid of Egypt against Babylon.<div eID="gen17075" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen17076" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">face--</hi>rather, thy eyes (<reference osisRef="Ezek.23.40">Eze 23:40</reference>). <div eID="gen17076" type="x-p"/>
